US and Iran agree to halt strikes, resume talks over Hormuz Strait

Iran and the United States have reportedly agreed to halt recent hostilities and resume talks concerning the Strait of Hormuz. A US official indicated that both sides will cease military actions, potentially leading to the normalization of commercial shipping and a decrease in oil prices. The discussions are expected to address the dispute over the vital waterway, which has been a focal point of recent tensions.
